title: OpenCAD2D drawing standard, version 1
description: A company's drawing standard, which drawing.check() scores a drawing against. Every member but schema and version is optional, and a rule whose member is absent is not run. Lengths on paper are millimetres.

name.description: The name of the standard, copied into the result.

layers.description: The layers a drawing may use (rules layer-name, layer-properties, layer-zero).

allowed.description: The layers allowed: a name or an AutoCAD wild-card pattern (WALL*, A-DOOR-??, case-blind) and, where given, the look every layer of that name has in the layer table. The first entry that matches a layer is the one used.

lineweight.description: Millimetres, as the layer's lineweight is (0.25, 0.35, 0.5 ...).

allowOthers.description: True turns the layer-name rule off: objects may be on layers the list does not name. False by default.

allowLayer0.description: False turns the layer-zero rule on: no object of a space may be on layer 0. The layer-name rule leaves layer 0 to it where this is given.

byLayer.description: Looks an object must leave to its layer; true turns the rule on.

textStyles.description: The text styles allowed (rules text-style, text-font).

dimStyles.description: The dimension styles allowed (rules dim-style, dim-font); the font is that of the style's text style.

textHeights.description: The heights words may have on paper (rule text-height).

paper.description: The allowed heights in millimetres on paper: 2.5, 3.5, 5, 7.

tolerance.description: How far from a listed height still counts as it, in millimetres. 0.01 by default.

gaps.description: The least gap on paper, in millimetres, around a word (rules gap-word-line, gap-word-word); each is run when it is given.

dimensionChains.description: Dimensions of one direction that meet end to end must share a dimension line (rule dim-chain).

tolerance.description: How far, on paper in millimetres, a dimension line may lie from the line of its chain. 0.5 by default.

reach.description: How far apart sideways two dimension lines may be and still be meant for one chain; further apart they are separate rows. 10 by default.

weights.description: The weight of each rule in the total score, by rule id; 1 where not given, 0 to keep a rule out of the total.

color.description: An AutoCAD colour number from 1 to 255, or a true colour as "#RRGGBB".

name.description: A style name or a wild-card pattern.

font.description: The font the style must use: a font file (simplex.shx, simplex) or a typeface (Arial), compared without folder, extension or case.
